findings.title: ZIP_STORED legitimate empty member rejected due to compress_size==0
findings.evidence: Python stdlib ZIP_STORED empty regular file has file_size=0/compress_size=0, so guard rejects it. This behavior was reproduced with isolated stdlib fixture, not original code's live release workflow.
findings.disposition: HOLD: #417/457 retired API artifact publisher; trace still-authorized usage and add explicit zero-length regression before proposing change.
